description: This file defines a utility class 'Toaster' used for displaying transient messages (toasts) in the Android UI. It manages message state, preventing duplicate messages, and uses coroutines to emit messages asynchronously.

classes.name: Toaster
classes.description: A utility class for managing and emitting toast messages within an Android application using Kotlin coroutines.

methods.name: showShort
methods.description: Displays a short-duration toast message if it is not a duplicate of the last message.

methods.name: showLong
methods.description: Displays a long-duration toast message if it is not a duplicate of the last message.

methods.name: sendChecking
methods.description: Checks if the message is new before emitting it; updates lastMessage state.
